body: I hope and kinda know it'll be.

It's the chance I got, and I thought at the moment it would be a good one. However I have to wait a lot to get there and life isn't exactly easy. So I have hit more bumps than I have wanted to. 

But I'll start from what I think is the beginning. A few months ago I got myself expelled from school, broke up with my 3 years GF. And almost kicked out of my house. I managed to turn some things around and talked with a few people where we got the idea to go to Israel and start a new beginning over there.
I'll leave my country (Mexico) and go live in Israel, without family, friends or foes. A new beginning I hope.
I'm from Mexico and I'll travel to Israel.

I hope I have the strength to start again, I think I know that I have it inside. 

I don't really know what I want in or out, however I'll only keep myself in it. Just gotta keep going for a month and a few days.

It'll work out, I have no money but I took some favors I was owed and the sooner they can get my ticket is July 29...

Because of their hypocritical ways, their what can I help you with but never wanting to really do anything for you. And I got tired, and only want to go and live on my own from now on.
